note: Attacker-controlled compressed block data (containing the RLE-compressed Huffman table bytes) is read from the FILE block into p; p is later handed to parse_tables.
When the block header's is_table_present flag is set, the attacker-controlled buffer p is passed to parse_tables for Huffman table decompression.
First nibble of the RLE stream is decoded; a value of 15 (ESCAPE) selects the run-length branch that fills bit_length with zeroes.
Second (ESCAPE) nibble is decoded: value=15 yields a run of value+2=17 zeroes written into bit_length[HUFF_BC] without re-checking w against HUFF_BC.

Root cause: the run-length fill loop only bounds k by value+2 (max 17) and never checks w < HUFF_BC (20), so a single ESCAPE run can push the write index w past the end of the 20-byte bit_length stack array.
Sink: out-of-bounds stack write. With w=19 at loop entry and value=15, indices 19..35 are written, overflowing bit_length[20] by 16 bytes.
